capabilities: Choose Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, a custom executable, or the system default for HTTP(S) links
Open a second browser when clicking with Alt, Ctrl, Shift, or Meta held
Intercept HTML anchor clicks and window.open() calls after user clicks
Run diagnostic commands that test primary and alternative browser launches
Fall back to the system default browser when launching fails
extras: Public beta, not yet approved for the Community directory; install via BRAT or manual download. Tested only on Windows; Linux and macOS untested. Intercepting window.open() is limited to 1.5 seconds after mouse input and may conflict with other plugins.
problem: Obsidian desktop always opens external links in the operating system's default browser, with no way to pick a different one per click.

relations.evidence: install BRAT, select Add a beta plugin for testing, and enter Radouch/obsidian-external-browser

requires.name: a web browser (chosen browser must be installed; system default otherwise)

summary: Desktop plugin that opens HTTP and HTTPS links in a browser you choose, with an optional second browser on modifier-click.
